test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

The art historian argued that the painting's value __has been greatly underestimated__, and that __its unique style and technique__ deserved __recognition from the art community and the public alike.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the tense 'has been' is incorrect. It should be **'had been'** to correctly describe the past condition.
 
• In the given sentence, the **past perfect tense** should be used to show that the painting's value was underestimated before the present discussion.
 
• Correct use of the past perfect tense provides clarity in the sequence of events.

Hence, the correct statement is "***The art historian argued that the painting's value had been greatly underestimated__, and that its unique style and technique deserved recognition from the art community and the public alike*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The part** "its unique style and technique"** does not have a grammatical error.
 
• The part **"recognition from the art community" **is correctly structured and grammatically sound.
 
• The part "**and the public alike"** is also correctly structured and grammatically sound.
